spec.rationale: Repeated experiments show KS/AUC tradeoffs and weak tail capture: V221 captures6 fewer defaults thanV25 in the top10% despite greater pooledKS. Test another proper scoring objective with unchanged data, without directly optimizing a selected KS threshold. Brier loss is nonconvex in logistic coefficients; stationary convergence does not establish a global optimum or better KS.
